title: Global 0.5° terrestrial water storage anomalies from a dynamic soft-constrained deep-learning downscaling of GRACE/GRACE-FO (Uz et al., GFZ)
description: Monthly terrestrial water storage anomalies (cm) at 0.5° (about 50 km) for global land areas excluding Greenland and Antarctica, April 2002 to December 2022, produced by spatially downscaling the JPL GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon solutions (about 300 km) with a deep-learning model guided simultaneously by the GRACE observations and by high-resolution patterns from the WaterGAP Global Hydrology Model and ERA5, with constraint weights adjusted dynamically during training. Each month includes a total predictive uncertainty combining aleatoric and epistemic components.
purpose: Provides an independent, openly licensed downscaled GRACE record with per-cell uncertainty, to compare against other downscaled products when interpreting storage change over Algeria.

creator: Metehan Uz (GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences), Kazım Gökhan Atman (Queen Mary University of London), Orhan Akyılmaz (Istanbul Technical University), C. K. Shum (The Ohio State University)

references.citation: Uz, M., Atman, K. G., Akyılmaz, O., and Shum, C. K. (2026). A dynamic soft-constrained deep learning paradigm for spatial downscaling of satellite gravimetry terrestrial water storage. Journal of Hydrology, 668, 135015.

spatial_extent.description: Global land areas excluding Greenland and Antarctica on a 0.5° grid (360 latitudes from 89.75° N to 89.75° S × 720 longitudes from 179.75° W to 179.75° E). Algeria lies within the land domain; values over Algeria were not checked. Users subset the single global file.

temporal_extent.description: April 2002 to December 2022; the data description gives 249 time steps, which equals every calendar month in that period, including months without GRACE/GRACE-FO observations.

resolution.spatial: 0.5° × 0.5° (about 50 km; GRACE input resolves about 300 km)

variables.name: twsa
variables.description: Downscaled terrestrial water storage anomaly (time, lat, lon)

variables.name: unc
variables.description: Total predictive uncertainty of the TWSA simulation (aleatoric + epistemic)

processing: Deep-learning spatial downscaling of the JPL GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon solutions (the data description cites RL06.1Mv03) from about 300 km to 0.5°. A dynamic soft-constraint paradigm guides the model simultaneously by the GRACE/GRACE-FO observations and by high-resolution spatial patterns from WaterGAP v2.2e and ERA5 monthly data; the weight of each constraint is updated at every training step according to the correlation between the prediction and the high-resolution inputs (data description).
validation: Not summarised in the data description; see Uz et al. (2026) in the Journal of Hydrology (not read for this record).
limitations: Total water storage anomaly, not groundwater.
The 0.5° detail is produced by the deep-learning model from WaterGAP and ERA5 patterns; it is not resolved by GRACE.

Months without GRACE/GRACE-FO data, including the 2017–2018 inter-mission gap, appear to be present in the 249-step series; how they were produced is not stated in the data description, so treat them as model estimates.
Ends in December 2022 and is not updated operationally; based on the older JPL RL06.1Mv03 mascons.

algeria_notes: A useful second opinion beside the Li & Kusche product: comparing the two downscaled records (and the raw JPL mascons) over Algeria shows how much of any sub-mascon pattern depends on the downscaling method. Note the coarser grid (0.5°) and the earlier end date (2022).
